source: Ossorio R., Marchante-Avellaneda J., Navarro-Peris E. (2024) Development of compact empirical models for variable-speed compressors for the prediction of energy consumption, mass flow and discharge temperature. Applied Thermal Engineering 244:122666. doi:10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2024.122666
status: Coefficients transcribed from journal. R290 raw data subsequently located in author doctoral thesis; see source_audit.

units.fc: shaft rev/s; source frequency convention for synchronous PM motor without slip, not generic electrical Hz
units.Wc: W (compressor plus inverter input, thesis Appendix 1)

power_boundary: Wc = total electrical consumption including inverter losses (Ossorio 2023 ATE230:120725 p.4 'consumption (including inverter losses)'; R454C xlsx header 'Wc + Winv'). Compressor-only (inverter-output) power exists only for the separate inverter test sheets (Ossorio2023_InverterA/B/C_points.csv) without state data.

eq10_mass_flow.form: mdot = (k0 + k1*Pe + k2*Pc + k3*Pe*Pc) * fc_rat * [k4*(fc_rat - k5/fc_nom)^2 + k6],  fc_rat = fc/fc_nom,  k6 = 1 - k4*(1 - k5/fc_nom)^2

eq17_specific_consumption.form: Wc/mdot_pred = [k0 + k1*(Pc - k2)/(Pe - k3)] * [k4*(fc_rat - k5/fc_nom)^2 + k6],  k6 = 1 - k4*(1 - k5/fc_nom)^2  (kJ/kg, bar, Hz). k5 = speed of maximum compressor efficiency.
eq17_specific_consumption.note: k4>0 with k5 inside the speed range => specific consumption has a minimum (efficiency maximum) at fc=k5 and rises toward both low and high speed: interior maximum in N.

eq22_electromechanical_loss.printed_form: eta_em = k0 + k1*PR + k2*PR/fc_rat + k3/Wc   (Eq.22, p.11)
eq22_electromechanical_loss.interpretation: f_loss = k0 + k1*PR + k2*PR/fc_rat + k3/Pel. Author thesis Eq3.22 gives eta_em=1-f_loss; raw-data check recorded in source_audit.
